chunks: And it is narrated that he said:
"Strike them for stumbling, but do not strike them for shying away, for they see what you do not see."

key_terms.النِّفَارِ: Shying away or bolting in fright
key_terms.الْعِثَارِ: Stumbling; a fault for which striking is mentioned
key_terms.اِضْرِبُوهَا: Strike her/them; a directive concerning disciplining the animal
key_terms.تَرَوْنَ: You see; referring to human perception
key_terms.تَرَى: She sees; indicating the animal's perception

ai.seo_question: When may an animal be struck, and when should it not be struck according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches measured and discerning treatment of animals, distinguishing between blameworthy behavior and a reaction caused by perceiving something hidden from humans. It emphasizes restraint and recognition that animals may sense dangers or realities that people do not perceive.
